title: Settings page information architecture for ordinary users

commits.message: Simplify Settings page IA for ordinary users (CHG-20260721-013).
Record CHG-20260721-013 as tested after settings IA polish.
Persist AI model validation snapshot for Settings readiness (CHG-20260721-013).

user_summary: 将设置页从技术配置后台重构为普通用户可理解的渐进式设置界面，技术诊断收进高级/开发者区域。
technical_summary: Root causes: config vs real probe conflated; validation not persisted; missing validated_at; duplicate verify buttons; consent vs ready contradiction. Added ApplicationSetting ai_service_validation_snapshot + connection_ui_state machine; consent hydrates from SQLite.
acceptance_criteria: Ordinary tabs hide license and tech jargon
AI shows one status + one primary CTA
Privacy hides channel/URL/install ID unless developer
Refresh restores verified_at from SQLite snapshot
verification_evidence: Phase A full gates 2026-07-22: pytest 723 passed/47 skipped; vitest 774 passed; typecheck pass; lint pass; check_project pass; template governance PASS; VERSION remained 1.0.3
